actions.reason: RegexTokenizer.train picked the top pair each merge step by building a list of all pair counts and scanning it with max, count and index. It now keeps a lazy max-heap of (-count, pair). An entry counts only while it matches the pair's current count, and each pair whose count changed is pushed again after the merge (once per pair). The pairs tied for the top count are popped from the heap. The existing earliest-occurrence tie-break (chunk, then position) does not depend on dict order, so the merges are identical. Evaluate: train_ir ratio 0.8968, equivalence identical, all tests pass.
